name: balance-card
title: Balance card
description: An account balance for fintech and marketplaces: the available and pending split, next payout, actions, a hide toggle and an overdrawn state in words.
docs: Figures are in major units. `hidden` is controlled and `defaultHidden` is not; `onToggleHidden` reports the new state. Hidden figures never reach the DOM as text. A date-only `nextPayout.date` ("2026-10-23") is a calendar day and reads the same in every time zone.
